InsightBench: Evaluating Business Analytics Agents Through Multi-Step Insight Generation
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

[Paper][Website][Dataset]
Insight-Bench is a benchmark dataset designed to evaluate end-to-end data analytics by evaluating agents' ability to perform comprehensive data analysis across diverse use cases, featuring carefully curated insights, an evaluation mechanism based on LLaMA-3-Eval or G-EVAL, and a data analytics agent, AgentPoirot.

evaluation_method: LLM-based automated evaluation (LLaMA-3-Eval / G-EVAL) with optional human review; scores reflect quality and completeness of generated insights
general_score_metric: Composite insight score produced by LLM-based evaluators (captures correctness, novelty, and actionability of insights)
reputation: New benchmark from ServiceNow aimed at evaluating data-analytics agents; gaining attention in agent/analytics evaluation but not yet widely standardized.
